gearingNotes: Critical rate is the defining gearing constraint for Hero. The class doc enumerates its always-on crit sources as base 5%, Chance Attack 20%, Decent Sharp Eyes 10%, Weapon Mastery 15%, plus 4% each from the Marksman and Night Lord level-200 Legion blocks, totalling 58%; the remaining ~42% needed to reach 100% has to come from the Legion grid (0-40%), Legion artifact, hyper stats (0-15%), familiar badges (1% each, capped at 3%) and, if you are not using the attack speed line, inner ability (20%). Because the bossing inner ability preset spends the top line on Attack Speed +1 rather than crit rate, the crit gap has to be closed elsewhere. Weapon choice: the class doc states axe carries an additional 5% damage over sword and recommends a two-handed weapon. Grandis Library separately records Hero's attack speed as stage 5 with a one-handed weapon versus stage 4 with a two-handed one (lower stage is faster); no source connects that fact to the Attack Speed +1 inner ability recommendation, and an earlier revision of this file asserted such a link in the wrong direction - that inference has been deleted, the two transcribed facts kept. Buff duration is worth investing in only up to 98% total as shown in the character stat window, per the class doc ('the maximum amount of buff duration we should be aiming for which is 98%, having less is also fine'); an earlier revision of this file said 97%, which appears in no source. The class doc's hat potential section treats cooldown reduction lines (-2s, -4s) as a real alternative to pure stat lines rather than a mistake. Legion board priority for bossing runs Critical Damage, then Boss Damage, then IED, then Buff Duration (to that 98% cap), then Critical Rate, then STR, then ATT; for training it runs Critical Damage, then EXP Obtained, then Normal Monster Damage, then Critical Rate, then STR, then ATT. All of the above is single-sourced to the class doc except the two Grandis attack-speed-stage figures. Nothing sourced here is specific to a level 104 character - every claim above concerns level 200+ progression.

commonMistakes.mistake: Jumping repeatedly while using Raging Blow, which cuts the number of attacks the skill lands.
Not watching cooldowns, which causes missed burst windows.
Using movement skills at the wrong moment and dying avoidably.
Letting the Puncture debuff lapse (it runs 60 seconds), which costs the party damage.
Not accounting for skill recovery frames, leading to positioning errors.

A third extraction on 2026-09-12 reported five items but could not pin the fifth. Unresolved, and outside this pass's endgame scope - left in place, flagged, not relied upon.

evidenceWarning: This file does NOT meet the three-independent-sources bar on any endgame field. Every claim in vMatrix, hexa, hyperStats, hyperSkills and innerAbility rests on ONE independent source, buffhero.win, and is labelled consensus 'weak' with sourceCount 1. Grandis Library agrees on inner ability, hyper passives and boost nodes but credits those exact fields to that same class doc, so its agreement carries no independent weight and does not raise any count. mystyjl's node guide is the only genuinely independent boost-node opinion and it disagrees with Grandis. buffhero.win carries no date or changelog, and the Hero Discord and reddit could not be reached.
